t: iHomeX: An Internet-Enabled Laboratory for Long-Term Experiment Management | IEEE Journals & Magazine | IEEE Xplore
s: Developing longtime laboratory experiments is a challenging problem, which requires users to frequently get to the laboratories. “iHomeX” tries to tackle this problem by opening real laboratories to remote access: people working on the experiments are required to go to the laboratory and physically arrange their setups, but later on they can manage the experiment from home.
